description: WOT AFR 12.6 is lean of the 11-12 band: one step richer on the secondaries (#1431 .107 -> #1432 .110), plus a small spark change.

response.explanation: At full throttle the engine is running a bit lean (12.6). Fit secondary jets #1432 (.110) in place of #1431 (.107), then declare the swap so the next runs can be compared.

jetting.rationale: secondary WOT cells: mean AFR 12.6 (n=200, std 0.07) is above the 11.0-12.0 band; one step richer

proposals.rationale: no knock indications, EGT steady; +1 deg at cruise
